body.objective: Students will be able to describe technology habits.
successCriteria: I can describe my technology habits
I can give opinions with 我觉得 wǒ juéde and reasons
I can compare technology use in China and Canada
body.hook: In China, people pay for almost everything with their phones: street food, bus fares, even donations, often with a QR code. Comparing technology habits in China and Canada is a great way to practise Mandarin and see how culture shapes technology.

study.title: 科技和我 Kējì hé wǒ
study.question: How do people in China and Canada use technology?
study.passage:
Technology vocabulary: 用手机 yòng shǒujī (use a phone), 发短信 fā duǎnxìn (send a text), 看视频 kàn shìpín (watch videos), 玩游戏 wán yóuxì (play games), 网上购物 wǎngshàng gòuwù (shop online), 手机支付 shǒujī zhīfù (mobile payment).
Duration: 我每天用手机两个小时。Wǒ měitiān yòng shǒujī liǎng ge xiǎoshí. = I use my phone two hours a day. (Time duration comes after the verb.)
Opinions: 我觉得…因为… wǒ juéde... yīnwèi... (I think... because...). 我觉得手机很方便，因为可以扫码付钱。
In China, apps such as WeChat (微信 Wēixìn) combine messaging, payment, ride-hailing and more in one app. Mobile payment by QR code is extremely common.
短文 Short text:
我叫李华，住在上海。我每天用手机三个小时。我用微信跟朋友聊天，也用手机买东西、坐地铁。我觉得手机支付很方便，可是有时候我用手机太多了。我的加拿大朋友杰克说，他常常用银行卡买东西。
Wǒ jiào Lǐ Huá, zhù zài Shànghǎi. Wǒ měitiān yòng shǒujī sān ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ yòng Wēixìn gēn péngyou liáotiān, yě yòng shǒujī mǎi dōngxi, zuò dìtiě. Wǒ juéde shǒujī zhīfù hěn fāngbiàn, kěshì yǒu shíhou wǒ yòng shǒujī tài duō le. Wǒ de Jiānádà péngyou Jiékè shuō, tā chángcháng yòng yínhángkǎ mǎi dōngxi.
Task: Survey classmates on technology habits, then compare with Lǐ Huá.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Give opinions with 我觉得 and 因为
Compare habits in China and Canada
discussion: How does Lǐ Huá use her phone differently from you?
Why might mobile payment be so common in China?
Is using a phone a lot a problem?
study.product: Present a 90-second talk in Mandarin about your technology habits, with three opinions using 我觉得…因为… and two comparisons with China.

examples.title: Duration
examples.problem: Say "I go online one hour a day."
examples.answer: 我每天上网一个小时。Wǒ měitiān shàng wǎng yí ge xiǎoshí.

examples.title: Opinion
examples.problem: Say "I think computers are convenient because I can do homework."
examples.answer: 我觉得电脑很方便，因为我可以做作业。

examples.title: Comparison
examples.problem: Say "Lǐ Huá uses her phone more than I do."
examples.answer: 李华比我用手机多。Lǐ Huá bǐ wǒ yòng shǒujī duō.

examples.title: Culture
examples.answer: Chat, pay, take the metro, shop
examples.explore: Is there one app like this in Canada?

practice.a: Chatting on WeChat, shopping, taking the metro.

practice.q: Translate: I watch videos every day.
practice.a: 我每天看视频。Wǒ měitiān kàn shìpín.

practice.q: Where does a time duration go in a Mandarin sentence?
What problem does Lǐ Huá mention?
practice.a: Sometimes she uses her phone too much.

practice.q: Why might one super-app be convenient?
practice.a: You can do many tasks without switching apps.

practice.q: Write an opinion about online shopping with a reason.
